title: Allow semantic extract check in worker ingress bridge
objective: Fix the worker ingress validator so READ_ONLY jobs can use the already integrated worker_result_semantic_extract check. This resolves the R3 rejection reasons READ_ONLY_ONLY_NON_MUTATING_CHECKS_ALLOWED and CHECK_1_INVALID_TYPE. Worker bridge infrastructure only; do not touch SQL, Production, Scheduler, NetPay, frontend, or Tablajeria business code.
hard_fail_conditions: Do not touch SQL or Production.
Do not touch Tablajeria business logic.
Do not touch frontend, Scheduler, NetPay, migrations, or API routes.
Fail if replacement count is not exactly 1.
Fail if write scope is outside the two allowed files.
Fail if tests do not pass.
next_after_success: Republish semantic extraction as EDARSAHUB-TABLAJERIA-R2-SEMANTIC-EXTRACT-READONLY-R4 because R3 is already terminal rejected.
next_after_failure: Report exact blocker; do not open Gate3.
